intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Stand up! It's time to dance!
chorus: Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!
verses: Rory says shake your head, shake, shake, shake,
Shake it like the jungle is starting to quake!
Shake your head along with me!
Ziggy says clap your paws, clap, clap, clap,
Clap them up and clap them in your lap!
Clap your paws along with me!
Waffles says wag your tail, wag, wag, wag,
Wiggle your bottom, zig and zag!
Wag your tail along with me!
Pebble says stomp your feet, stomp, stomp, stomp,
Stomp them like a penguin, romp, romp, romp!
Stomp your feet along with me!
bridge: Shake your head! Clap your paws!
Wag your tail! Stomp your feet!
